主要内容: BROADWAY FINANCIAL CORP (BYFC) reported that a Schedule 13D filing was submitted to the Securities and Exchange Commission on February 10, 2020, by Steven A. Sugarman and associated entities, indicating ownership of shares in Broadway Financial Corporation. The filing included a letter to the board of directors, signed by officers of two Sugarman Entities. In response, Wayne-Kent A. Bradshaw, President and Chief Executive Officer of Broadway, issued a letter addressed to the board, which is attached as Exhibit 99.1 to this Form 8-K. The filing does not disclose any changes in the company's operations, financials, or strategic direction, but highlights shareholder ownership changes and internal communications related to governance.
